name: Forney (United States)
description: Divided horizontally blue over red, charged with the city's white stylised F logo and the name FORNEY in white.
history: Forney is a city in Kaufman County, Texas, and has been named by the Texas Legislature as the "Antique Capital of Texas". The flag was adopted in 2012 (chosen by the city council from three options after the city changed its logo in 2012, according to Flags of the World citing inForney).

features.role: stylised F logo and the name FORNEY
